about_the_game:
For the first time in the history of Trailmakers, experience the soundtrack available on Steam in high quality!

Created by sound designer and composer at Flashbulb Games, Carl Lindegaard, the soundtrack features 29 tracks carefully crafted to capture the essence of Trailmakers and Planet Gregory.

Relax to the tunes from the Froggit settlements, let your mind drift to the lush exploration music from all the different biomes or get your heart racing in the awesome soup of guitars and synths from the Mega Drill boss battle, composed in collaboration with metal artist Catarinth (also known as the legendary Trailmaker and content creator ScrapMan).

Blending acoustic instruments such as guitar, melodica and handpan with orchestral instruments, electric guitars and digital synths, the soundtrack for Pioneers is a richly textured experience offering everything from relaxing soundscapes to funky Froggit beats.

short_description: Explore the sonic landscapes of the groundbreaking Trailmakers update, Pioneers. More than 25 tracks will carry you through the rolling hills of the Meadows, deep into the Mudflats, and soaring through the skies above the Treetops.
